subject.title: fix(agents): carry provenance through active subagent wakes

question: Should active subagent wake provenance be exposed through the public `AgentSession.steer` options API, or kept behind an internal queue/transcript context while preserving current sender metadata?
rationale: The behavior fix is useful, but the PR changes a public agent-session surface and now intersects current main's queued transcript metadata, so API ownership needs maintainer intent before merge.

options.title: Approve combined queue metadata
options.body: Rebase with one option shape that carries both `inputProvenance` and `userTurnTranscriptRecorder`, then land after focused tests and refreshed proof.

options.title: Keep provenance internal
options.body: Move provenance threading behind an internal active-wake queue helper and avoid expanding the public `AgentSession.steer` API.

options.title: Pause this PR
options.body: Leave the branch open or ask for a replacement PR if maintainers want a broader subagent/session-state design first.

recommendation.title: Approve combined queue metadata
recommendation.body: Rebase with one option shape that carries both `inputProvenance` and `userTurnTranscriptRecorder`, then land after focused tests and refreshed proof.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete merged the current-main transcript metadata work and adjacent active-run ownership work, making him the best visible owner for the API/rebase direction.
